# Rugby Management Worldwide

> A global rugby platform headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa: international rugby tours for schools and clubs, sevens festivals (Global Elite 7s), rugby camps and clinics, a rugby community and ambassador programme, rugby business education and a store for rugby training equipment. Contact: +27 76 583 9987, info@rugbyworldwide.co.za.

## Pages

- [School & Club Rugby Tours, Sevens Festivals | RMWW Cape Town](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/): International school and club rugby tours led by founder Warren Edwards, the Global Elite 7s in Cape Town, rugby camps and a rugby equipment store.
- [International Rugby Tours for Schools & Clubs | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/global-rugby-tours/): Rugby tours planned end to end: flights, accommodation, fixtures, training, excursions and live pro matches, for school, club and academy teams.
- [Dubai 7s & Global Youth 7s Rugby Tour Packages | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/travel-packages/): Rugby tour packages to the Dubai 7s (u19, from R45,000) and the Global Youth 7s (u18). Team entries and an invitational squad for individual players.
- [Rugby Festivals & Tournaments 2027 | Cape Town | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/events/): Upcoming rugby events: Global Elite 7s u23 sevens (26 to 28 Nov 2027, Cape Town), Pre-Season Rugby Camp (Jan 2027) and Dubai 7s tours.
- [Global Elite 7s 2027 | U23 Sevens Rugby, Cape Town](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/global-elite-7s/): International u23 sevens festival in Cape Town, 26 to 28 November 2027: 48 men's and women's teams. Winner gets free entry to the Mauritius series 2028.
- [Rugby Camp Western Cape | Pre-Season Camp Jan 2027 | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/camp-clinics/): 5-day pre-season rugby camp for ages 12 to 17 at Delsma Farm, Riebeek-Kasteel, 8 to 12 January 2027. Accommodation and meals included, R4,999.99.
- [Global Rugby Community Membership | Free to R24,995 | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/community/): Join the Global Rugby Community: free supporter tier, or Member, Pro, Business, Executive and Founder memberships for players, coaches, clubs and businesses.
- [Rugby Ambassador Programme | Earn Rewards Points | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/ambassador-programme/): Refer members to the Global Rugby Community and earn Rugby Rewards Points to upgrade your membership. Use the calculator and climb the leaderboard.
- [Rugby Business Management Course (8 Weeks Online) | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/education/): Start a career on the business side of rugby with the 8-week online Rugby Business Management course from Sports Management Worldwide. Live Zoom chats.
- [About Warren Edwards & RMWW | Rugby Management Worldwide](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/about-us/): Rugby Management Worldwide was founded by former semi-pro player Warren Edwards to give school teams, academies and players international rugby tours.
- [School Rugby Tours Abroad | Rugby Management Worldwide](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/school-rugby-tours/): International school rugby tours from Cape Town: fixtures against overseas schools, training, flights, accommodation and excursions, planned end to end.
- [Contact Us | Rugby Management Worldwide | +27 76 583 9987](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/contact/): Contact Rugby Management Worldwide in Cape Town about rugby tours, Global Elite 7s, camps, membership, store orders or teamwear. WhatsApp, phone or email.
- [Rugby Equipment & Scrum Machines South Africa | RMWW Store](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-store/): Buy RHINO scrum machines, rugby balls, kicking tees, protection, kit bags and training equipment in South Africa. 54 products, secure checkout.
- [Custom Rugby Teamwear Quote | Kits for Schools & Clubs | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/quote-request-teamwear/): Get a quote for custom rugby teamwear: playing kits for 15, 23 or 30 players plus warm-up tops, hoodies, jackets and bench coats for schools and clubs.
- [Global Elite 7s 2027 in Cape Town: team entry | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-guides/global-elite-7s-2027-cape-town-team-entry/): Global elite 7s in Cape Town, 26 to 28 November 2027: who can enter, the 48-team u23 format, the trip schedule and how to register your team.
- [How to choose a scrum machine for your team | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-guides/how-to-choose-a-scrum-machine/): A practical guide to choosing a scrum machine for a school or club: sleds versus multi-person machines, space, transport, storage, safety and coaching.
- [How to plan a school rugby tour: coach checklist | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-guides/how-to-plan-a-school-rugby-tour-abroad/): Planning a school rugby tour abroad? A step-by-step checklist for coaches: dates, party size, fixtures, budget and the parents meeting.
- [Rugby Camp Western Cape: Pre-Season at Delsma | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-guides/rugby-camp-western-cape-pre-season-delsma-farm/): Rugby camp Western Cape guide: what 5 days and 4 nights at Delsma Farm offer players aged 12 to 17, from the field and gym to the pool and meals.
- [Rugby tour New Zealand: a school team planner | RMWW](https://rugbyworldwide.co.za/rugby-guides/rugby-tour-new-zealand-school-teams/): Planning a rugby tour New Zealand trip for your school? Why it works, what a fixture week looks like and how to visit the famous test stadium in Auckland.
